vapor-specter.name: Vapor Specter
vapor-specter.description: A replicant cloned from a Warframe which can be deployed to assist Tenno on their missions.

vapor-specter-regiment.name: Vapor Specter Regiment
vapor-specter-regiment.description: An army composed of vapor-level Specter clones to be used in defense of the clan's Solar Rail. This Specter army will persist for one conflict.

vasca-curative.name: Vasca Curative
vasca-curative.description: Known as 'lisau heisah' by the Ostrons, this is a traditionally-brewed remedy for the Vasca virus. Once applied any infected Kavats within a short radius are cured.

vasca-kavat-echo-lure.name: Vasca Kavat Echo-Lure
vasca-kavat-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Vasca Kavat with life-like animal calls. Vasca Kavat roam the Plains of Eidolon at night.

vasca-kavat-pheromone-oota.name: Vasca Kavat Pheromone Oota
vasca-kavat-pheromone-oota.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Vasca Kavat.

vermillion-antitoxin.name: Vermillion Antitoxin
vermillion-antitoxin.description: This is an extremely effective antitoxin.

virmink-echo-lure.name: Virmink Echo-Lure
virmink-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Virmink with life-like animal calls. The Virmink is most often found around the Lakes in Orb Vallis.

virmink-pheromone-synthesizer.name: Virmink Pheromone Synthesizer
virmink-pheromone-synthesizer.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Virmink.

vome-residue.name: Vome Residue
vome-residue.description:
A gobbet of raw flesh, fallen from the wyrm Vome in her death spasm. Used to attract Chondricord and Duriod in Cambion Drift cave hotspots during Fass and Vome.

Location: Cambion Drift on Deimos while Fass is active

vortex.name: Vortex
vortex.description: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.

vulpaphyla-echo-lure.name: Vulpaphyla Echo-Lure
vulpaphyla-echo-lure.description: Entice and attract nearby Vulpaphyla with life-like animal calls.

vulpaphyla-pheromone-gland.name: Vulpaphyla Pheromone Gland
vulpaphyla-pheromone-gland.description: Deploy just before using the echo-lure to increase the chance of attracting a rarer subspecies of Vulpaphyla.
